articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: UK regulator plans tighter DeFi rules, citing $6.3B Binance hack: Report
articles.description: North Korea-linked hackers used DeFi protocols to launder stolen Binance funds, while US prosecutors moved to recover more than $1.1 billion in crypto.

articles.title: Sky proposes emergency vote on $25M transfer amid liquidity stress
articles.description: Sky’s Core Facilitator invoked the protocol’s emergency response process to expedite a vote rather than wait until the next scheduled vote on Dec. 3.

articles.title: 1Password hacker stole customer names and emails, but vaults safe
articles.description: The password manager, which is used by millions of people to store their login credentials, said customer vaults were unaffected by the breach.

articles.title: Senate Democrats urge SEC to scrap crypto, tokenized stock exemptions
articles.description: US Senators Elizabeth Warren and Chris Van Hollen, among others, have taken aim at two recent SEC efforts to ease regulatory requirements for the crypto industry.

articles.title: AI labs likely sitting on cryptography ‘bombshells,’ computer scientist says
articles.description: AI is driving a massive wave of mathematical breakthroughs which could have implications for cryptography.

articles.title: Switzerland clears 57 jurisdictions for crypto tax data sharing
articles.description: The move paves the way for Switzerland to exchange crypto tax data with foreign authorities starting in 2028 as part of a global effort to combat tax evasion.

articles.title: Braiins warns of Bitcoin mining attacks affecting over 1,000 sites
articles.description: Bitcoin mining pool operator Braiins warned that attackers are exploiting unsecured connections to hijack miners’ computing power and potentially steal rewards.

articles.title: Why ECB collateral eligibility could boost demand for tokenized bonds
articles.description: Past ECB decisions offer clues to the value of using bonds as collateral, while US derivatives exchanges face a different calculation over their Bitcoin holdings.

articles.title: Ethereum Foundation backs Keccak-256 to counter quantum, AI threats
articles.description: Ethlabs co-founder Julian Ma told Cointelegraph that AI poses a more immediate threat as Ethereum prepares for one of its biggest security overhauls since the Merge.

articles.title: US inflation rises to 3.8% ahead of December Fed meeting, clouding crypto outlook
articles.description: US core inflation rose more than expected in October as markets anticipate a December interest rate hike, which could slow a crypto market recovery.

articles.title: Bitcoin falls toward $57K amid US tariff fears, hot PCE data as Nasdaq drops 4%
articles.description: The prospect of higher US tariffs and hotter-than-expected PCE inflation weighed on Bitcoin, crypto and stocks on Wednesday.

articles.title: Nvidia agrees to $290M settlement over crypto mining revenue disclosures
articles.description: The proposed settlement would resolve a shareholder lawsuit dating back to 2018 that alleged Nvidia misled investors about its exposure to the cryptocurrency industry.

articles.title: FCC authorizes SpaceX to deploy 1M satellites for orbital AI data centers
articles.description: The planned Starmind constellation will process data in orbit for use on Earth, as demand for artificial intelligence computing power continues to grow.

articles.title: Ex-FTX COO calls out Netflix over CZ’s ‘Asian mafia’ portrayal
articles.description: Constance Waing said Netflix used racist stereotypes in its portrayal of CZ and misrepresented life at FTX before the exchange’s collapse.

articles.title: Ukraine passes bill to legalize crypto and tax profits at 23%
articles.description: Ukraine’s parliament passed a crypto regulation bill after three years of legislative work, with the new rules set to take effect in July 2027.

articles.title: Japan’s SBI, SMFG launch Solana venture for stablecoins, tokenization
articles.description: SBI Solana Global plans to develop stablecoin payment infrastructure, explore AI agent micropayments and tokenize financial assets.

articles.title: Hong Kong launches tokenized debt platform with 24-hour settlement
articles.description: The HKMA’s new platform supports settlement in multiple currencies and handles debt issuance, interest payments and repayment at maturity.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs near $5B in record monthly outflows amid AI stock rout
articles.description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs have recorded $4.94 billion in November net outflows, exceeding the previous monthly record of $4.51 billion set in June.

articles.title: Bitcoin price may fall below $53K if bear-market history repeats
articles.description: Bitcoin price downside targets focused on the $53,200 realized price as research saw pointed to bear-market patterns continuing for BTC/USD.

articles.title: HYPE drops 8% as Trump bump gives way to 40% slide from peak
articles.description: HYPE traded below its price before Trump’s August remarks as wallets linked to Abraxas Capital reportedly exited the Hyperliquid platform.

articles.title: French Senate rejects 100K euro crypto wallet disclosure requirement
articles.description: Senators also rejected stablecoin-swap and crypto exit-tax proposals, while the 2027 budget remains under parliamentary consideration.

articles.title: Stablecoin redemptions hit $12B in 30 days, echoing 2022 bear market
articles.description: Crypto research firm Kaiko said the cash-out was smaller than in 2022 and has slowed, with stablecoin supply down just 0.4% since Nov. 13.

articles.title: EU seeks up to $55B for AI and quantum computing fund: Report
articles.description: Hackers already use AI to target crypto exchanges, while future quantum computers could break the cryptography that protects users’ funds.

articles.title: South Korea’s crypto bill could move stablecoin race beyond token issuance
articles.description: South Korea’s draft bill favors bank-led stablecoin issuance but allows fintech and technology companies to become the largest individual shareholders.

articles.title: Solana DEX Velocity halts trading over bug just months after relaunch
articles.description: Velocity relaunched in September as a rebuilt version of Drift Protocol, which was attacked by North Korean hackers in April.

articles.title: Trump willing to pardon Jensen Huang, says it won’t be necessary
articles.description: The president’s remarks come days before Jensen Huang is due to face congressional questioning over national security concerns and US chip export controls.

articles.title: CleanSpark weighs selling more Bitcoin than it mines to de-risk books
articles.description: The Bitcoin miner sold 2,102 BTC while it produced just 1,708 BTC in the September quarter.

articles.title: Hackers breach CIA intelligence network in latest US cyberattack
articles.description: The reported breach follows cyber incidents involving the FBI, Department of Homeland Security and Department of Agriculture.

articles.title: Europol follows $28.5M crypto trail in streaming piracy crackdown
articles.description: Authorities from 11 countries worked with Binance, Coinbase and Chainalysis to trace financial transactions and disrupt illegal streaming services.
